title: Brazilian Shrimp Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy shrimp wrap with Brazilian inspiration, featuring roasted shrimp in a wrap with crispy onions and cilantro.
instructions: Rinse the shrimp and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the marinade and toss to coat. Let it sit for 10 minutes.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the shrimp in a single layer.
Roast the shrimp in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until they're pink and cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced onion and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the roasted shrimp, crispy onion, and chopped cilantro on one half of the wrap.
Drizzle with the remaining marinade and fold the wrap in half to serve.
